∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (T : outputs.Algorithms.BirchSgd.Tree) (gamma : ℝ)
  (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
  Measurable (Function.uncurry g) →
    ∀ (k : ℕ),
      (∀ (j : ℕ), Measurable fun η => (T.realize gamma x0 g η k).nodes j) ∧
        ∀ (c : ℕ), Measurable fun η => (T.realize gamma x0 g η k).replies c
